verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own dashboard supports filtering by release to find which release introduced errors, and shows release annotations on a timeline that correlates versions with error-rate changes. Stability monitoring against targets and a view of newly introduced errors add trend context, but the evidence is per-project, with no documented cross-project or per-team rollup dashboard. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregate dashboards, explicit top-regressions view, detailed docs on volume-over-time charts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time
